title: Inside Man: How Chinese spies used lies, love and betrayal to target the Federal Reserve
summary: The CNBC investigation delves into the intricate web of espionage surrounding former Federal Reserve advisor John Rogers, who became involved with an individual identified by U.S. officials as a Chinese intelligence operative. This case highlights the vulnerabilities within the Federal Reserve and raises concerns about foreign influence on American economic policy. Through deception, romantic entanglements, and betrayal, the investigation reveals the lengths to which foreign agents may go to infiltrate critical financial institutions.
